items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I just did an interview not that long ago with a fellow named Hank Cicalo. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh sure.

ctx.x: Well I do some courses, like master classes down at Peabody. I will bring down some SNL material and we’ll play that and we’ll talk about problems or listen to this leakage, listen to what we’re doing here; and then there’ve been other times when we’ve brought in some local musicians and they all know it’s kind of like these guys are going be actually watching us like this was an operating theater. But I’ll work with the class and we’ll set up and we’ll record like a small fusion jazz ensemble and okay well let’s…
I’m so happy to hear you say that. I just did an interview not that long ago with a fellow named Hank Cicalo.
